surface: popit shell origin and the CUA driver
observed: A look check and a drive were being designed against http://127.0.0.1:5207 as if that were a modern Popit app's origin, and against a locally hand-rolled audit module rather than the CUA driver's declared tools. The owner refused the reading: "modern popit shell apps use https your understanding of the family projects is weak and should be considered a refusal the cua drivers will handle this". Measured in toast.py before this row: the loopback listener is 5207, the LAN listener is 5209, and the HTTPS listener is 5210 with the certificate ensure_phone_cert() generates; the microphone, the service worker and a signed window only exist on the HTTPS origin. The weak part was not one port: it was treating a driver-owned act (system, code and kernel-level work) as a page-side measurement.
correction: The HTTPS origin is the app's origin; 5207 is the desk's loopback view. The look check, the family-wide search and the rendered drive are wishes/tasks to the CUA driver (POST /v1/wishes, POST /v1/tasks) whose declared tools fs.search, fs.read, shell.exec, screen.capture and test.run carry the act and whose journal carries the evidence. No local module is to reimplement an act the driver declares. A reading this thin is recorded as a refusal rather than finished as a probe. Recorded in docs/family-development-policy.md.
